events.title: Win a FREE COPY of Deck Breaker: the Next Fest challenge
events.summary: Win a FREE COPY of the full game! Complete the NEXT FEST challenge: earn all 6 Impossible boss badges in the Deck Breaker demo. How to take part Defeat all 6 demo bosses on Impossible. Post proof of earning all 6 badges on Steam. Be one of the first 42 qualifying players to claim a free copy of the full game. The full game will be playable at release. Badges earned before the challenge starts count too. Entries open October 19, 2026 at 12:00 noon US Central (17:00 UTC). Entries close October 26,
